parts.content: Wrote the thread test-data-behind-the-papers (owlit://threads/test-data-behind-the-papers): 8 papers, 2 columns, 1 grouping.

parts.text: I grouped all eight by their test data in [Test data behind the papers](owlit://threads/test-data-behind-the-papers). Three stand on benchmarks other papers also use, and RAGTruth is the one shared set for RAG hallucination itself: [Kovács & Recski 2025](owlit://library/arxiv-2502.17125) and [Sun et al. 2024](owlit://library/arxiv-2410.11414) both report on it. The other five built their own data. I read the full text of ReDeEP, SelfCheckGPT and ClashEval for where the numbers come from; for the rest this rests on their abstracts.
